ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is the Arabic word مَا اسْمُكَ؟ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. maa ismuka?
   B. shukran
   C. ahlan wa sahlan
   D. as-salaamu ʿalaykum

2. How is the Arabic word مَسَاءُ الْخَيْرِ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. as-salaamu ʿalaykum
   B. sabaahu l-khayr
   C. marhaban
   D. masaa'u l-khayr

3. Which Arabic sentence means "My sister reads." (1 mark)
   A. هَذِهِ أُمِّي
   B. أُخْتِي تَقْرَأُ
   C. عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ
   D. هَذَا أَبِي

4. Which pair of words are two family members from the father's side and the mother's side? (1 mark)
   A. ʿamm and khaal
   B. akh and ukht
   C. ibn and bint
   D. ab and umm

5. What is imitative speaking? (1 mark)
   A. Reading silently
   B. Writing from memory
   C. Speaking without a model
   D. Listening carefully and copying what you hear

6. What does the Arabic word بَيْتٌ (bayt) mean? (1 mark)
   A. book
   B. pen
   C. house
   D. kitchen

7. What does the Arabic sentence أَيْنَ الْكِتَابُ؟ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The book is on the table.
   B. The lamp is above the table.
   C. Where is the book?
   D. The cat is under the bed.

8. What does the Arabic word بَطَاطِسُ (bataatis) mean? (1 mark)
   A. maize
   B. tomatoes
   C. eggs
   D. potatoes

9. What does the Arabic word ارْفَعْ يَدَكَ (irfaʿ yadaka) mean? (1 mark)
   A. listen
   B. stand up
   C. raise your hand
   D. read

10. How is the Arabic word رَقَبَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. yad
   B. wajh
   C. isbaʿ
   D. raqaba

11. What does the Arabic sentence أَزْرَعُ شَجَرَةً mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is rainy.
   B. The weather is cold.
   C. The weather is hot.
   D. I plant a tree.

12. Which sentence means 'I plant a tree'? (1 mark)
   A. azraʿu shajara
   B. nuhaafidhu ʿalaa l-bii'a
   C. al-maa'u nadhiif
   D. laa narmii l-qumaama

13. What does the Arabic sentence الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is rainy.
   B. The weather is hot.
   C. The weather is cold.
   D. The weather is cloudy.

14. What is the name of the Arabic letter ض? (1 mark)
   A. thaa
   B. Daad
   C. taa
   D. ghayn

15. Which sound does the Arabic letter خ make? (1 mark)
   A. th as in think
   B. kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch
   C. s as in sun
   D. f as in fan

16. What is the name of the Arabic letter و? (1 mark)
   A. siin
   B. daal
   C. Haa
   D. waaw

17. What does the word يَا (yaa) do in مَرْحَبًا يَا أَحْمَدُ? (1 mark)
   A. It means 'in'
   B. It means 'and'
   C. It means 'my'
   D. It calls a person, like 'O' or 'hey'

18. Which Arabic word means "mother's sister"? (1 mark)
   A. أَبٌ
   B. خَالَةٌ
   C. أُسْرَةٌ
   D. جَدَّةٌ

19. Which Arabic sentence means "On the table there is a cup." (1 mark)
   A. عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ
   B. فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ وَكُرْسِيٌّ
   C. الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ
   D. أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ

20. What is a good way to give peer feedback on reading? (1 mark)
   A. Say nothing
   B. Say what went well and give one tip to improve
   C. Laugh at mistakes
   D. Only point out errors

21. How is the Arabic word هَدِيَّةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. hadiyya
   B. raqs
   C. sadiiq
   D. ʿiid miilaad

22. How is the Arabic word دَوْرُكَ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. mabruuk
   B. dawruka
   C. ʿasiir
   D. kaʿka

23. Which Arabic sentence means "This is a party." (1 mark)
   A. الْأَصْدِقَاءُ فِي الْحَفْلَةِ
   B. عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كَعْكَةٌ
   C. فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ
   D. هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ

24. What does the Arabic sentence الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like food.
   B. Water is useful (good for you).
   C. The fish is delicious.
   D. The juice is cold.

25. How is the Arabic word دَجَاجٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. sukkar
   B. bayd
   C. dajaaj
   D. aruzz

26. What is a reader's theatre? (1 mark)
   A. A silent reading time
   B. A drawing competition
   C. A group reads a script aloud with expression
   D. A spelling test

27. Which Arabic word means "mouth"? (1 mark)
   A. فَمٌ
   B. يَدٌ
   C. جِسْمٌ
   D. رِجْلٌ

28. How is the Arabic word حَارٌّ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. matar
   B. shajara
   C. haarr
   D. shams

29. What goes on the back of a vocabulary flashcard? (1 mark)
   A. Only the date
   B. The sound and the meaning
   C. A long story
   D. Nothing

30. Which letter has one dot above it? (1 mark)
   A. ب (baa)
   B. ت (taa)
   C. ن (nuun)
   D. ي (yaa)

31. How is the Arabic word حَدِيقَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. saaʿa
   B. kuub
   C. hadiiqa
   D. matbakh

32. What is a class portfolio? (1 mark)
   A. A folder of the class's best work
   B. A kind of desk
   C. A single picture
   D. A test paper

33. What does the Arabic sentence الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The window is clean.
   B. The table is small.
   C. The chair is new.
   D. The door is big.

34. Which Arabic sentence means "The banana is delicious." (1 mark)
   A. الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ
   B. جَدَّتِي تُحِبُّنِي
   C. أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ
   D. آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ

35. What does the Arabic word بَطْنٌ (batn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. finger
   B. stomach
   C. mouth
   D. hand

36. Which Arabic sentence means "My hand is small." (1 mark)
   A. أَغْسِلُ وَجْهِي
   B. يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ
   C. رَأْسِي كَبِيرٌ
   D. أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي

37. Which line of the poem means 'My nose smells'? (1 mark)
   A. famii yatakallamu
   B. anfii yashummu
   C. udhunii tasmaʿu
   D. ʿaynii taraa

38. Which Arabic word means "sky"? (1 mark)
   A. سَمَاءٌ
   B. مِصْبَاحٌ
   C. ذُرَةٌ
   D. تَحْتَ

39. What does the Arabic sentence أُحِبُّ بَيْتِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like my house.
   B. In the room there is a bed.
   C. In the kitchen there is a table.
   D. This is my room.

40. Which Arabic word means "on"? (1 mark)
   A. تَحْتَ
   B. عَلَى
   C. بِجَانِبِ
   D. عِنْدَ

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into English: usaaʿidu ummii yawma s-sabt (2 marks)

42. Give three checks you should do after writing a sentence in Arabic. (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into English: haadhihi hafla (2 marks)

44. Explain why dots are important in Arabic letters. Give an example. (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: al-miftaahu fii l-khizaana (2 marks)

46. Name four key words about the home in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)

47. Translate into English: lii yadaani (2 marks)

48. Translate into English: haadhaa raʾsii (2 marks)

49. Write one Arabic sentence about today's weather in sounds and translate it. (2 marks) (2 marks)

50. Translate into English: an-naafidhatu nadhiifa (2 marks)

51. Translate into English: anaa bi-khayr, al-hamdu lillaah (2 marks)

52. List four theme words about the home in Arabic (English letters), with meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)

53. Translate into English: atakallamu bi-famii (2 marks)

54. Write five parts of the body in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

55. Translate into English: ʿiid miilaad saʿiid (2 marks)

56. Complete the word شُكْ_ا with the missing letter and give its meaning. (2 marks) (2 marks)

57. Translate into English: ash-shamsu haarra (2 marks)

58. Translate into English: al-baabu kabiir (2 marks)

59. Read the sentence اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ and write its meaning. (2 marks) (2 marks)

60. Translate into English: anaa araa biʿaynii (2 marks)

61. Translate into English: haadhaa abii (2 marks)

62. Translate into English: jismii qawiyy (2 marks)

63. Describe how to copy a family word neatly. (3 marks) (3 marks)

64. Translate into English: ismii Ahmad (2 marks)

65. Translate into English: al-baytu kabiir (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — maa ismuka?
   مَا اسْمُكَ؟ is read maa ismuka? and means What is your name? (to a boy).

2. D — masaa'u l-khayr
   مَسَاءُ الْخَيْرِ is read masaa'u l-khayr and means good evening.

3. B — أُخْتِي تَقْرَأُ
   أُخْتِي تَقْرَأُ (ukhtii taqraʾu) means: My sister reads.

4. A — ʿamm and khaal
   ʿamm is the father's brother and khaal is the mother's brother.

5. D — Listening carefully and copying what you hear
   In imitative speaking we listen to a speaker and copy the sounds, speed and tone.

6. C — house
   بَيْتٌ (bayt) means house.

7. C — Where is the book?
   أَيْنَ الْكِتَابُ؟ (ayna l-kitaab?) means: Where is the book?

8. D — potatoes
   بَطَاطِسُ (bataatis) means potatoes.

9. C — raise your hand
   ارْفَعْ يَدَكَ (irfaʿ yadaka) means raise your hand.

10. D — raqaba
   رَقَبَةٌ is read raqaba and means neck.

11. D — I plant a tree.
   أَزْرَعُ شَجَرَةً (azraʿu shajara) means: I plant a tree.

12. A — azraʿu shajara
   azraʿu means I plant and shajara means tree.

13. A — The weather is rainy.
   الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ (al-jawwu mumtir) means: The weather is rainy.

14. B — Daad
   The letter ض is called Daad.

15. B — kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch
   The letter خ makes the sound kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch.

16. D — waaw
   The letter و is called waaw.

17. D — It calls a person, like 'O' or 'hey'
   yaa is used to call someone by name.

18. B — خَالَةٌ
   خَالَةٌ (khaala) means mother's sister.

19. A — عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ
   عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ (ʿalaa t-taawilati kuub) means: On the table there is a cup.

20. B — Say what went well and give one tip to improve
   Feedback should be honest and kind.

21. A — hadiyya
   هَدِيَّةٌ is read hadiyya and means gift.

22. B — dawruka
   دَوْرُكَ is read dawruka and means your turn.

23. D — هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ
   هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ (haadhihi hafla) means: This is a party.

24. B — Water is useful (good for you).
   الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ (al-maa'u mufiid) means: Water is useful (good for you).

25. C — dajaaj
   دَجَاجٌ is read dajaaj and means chicken.

26. C — A group reads a script aloud with expression
   In a reader's theatre learners read a script aloud, using their voices to act.

27. A — فَمٌ
   فَمٌ (fam) means mouth.

28. C — haarr
   حَارٌّ is read haarr and means hot.

29. B — The sound and the meaning
   The Arabic word is on the front. The back shows the sound and the meaning.

30. C — ن (nuun)
   nuun has one dot above. Baa has one dot below, taa has two dots above and yaa has two dots below.

31. C — hadiiqa
   حَدِيقَةٌ is read hadiiqa and means garden.

32. A — A folder of the class's best work
   A portfolio keeps work together to be shown and reviewed.

33. C — The chair is new.
   الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ (al-kursiyyu jadiid) means: The chair is new.

34. A — الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ
   الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ (al-mawzu ladhiidh) means: The banana is delicious.

35. B — stomach
   بَطْنٌ (batn) means stomach.

36. B — يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ
   يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ (yadii Sagiira) means: My hand is small.

37. B — anfii yashummu
   anf is nose and yashummu means smells.

38. A — سَمَاءٌ
   سَمَاءٌ (samaa') means sky.

39. A — I like my house.
   أُحِبُّ بَيْتِي (uhibbu baytii) means: I like my house.

40. B — عَلَى
   عَلَى (ʿalaa) means on.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: I help my mother on Saturday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Did I write from right to left? Are the letters neat and joined? Are the dots and marks in place? Does the sentence make sense?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid check.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is a party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Some letters have the same body shape and differ only by their dots. For example baa has one dot below, taa has two dots above and thaa has three dots above.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for same shape, 1 mark for dots make the difference and 1 mark for a correct example.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: The key is in the cupboard.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example bayt (house), ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), taawila (table).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have two hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my head.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example al-jawwu baarid. The weather is cold.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a correct sentence and 1 mark for the translation.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: The window is clean.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am well, thanks be to God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example bayt (house), matbakh (kitchen), taawila (table), kursii (chair).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: I speak with my mouth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

54. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example raʾs (head), wajh (face), shaʿr (hair), ʿayn (eye), udhun (ear).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: Happy birthday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: شُكْرًا: the missing letter is raa (ر). It means thank you.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the letter and 1 mark for the meaning.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: The sun is hot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: The door is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: ismii Ahmad. My name is Ahmad.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for reading and 1 mark for meaning.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: I see with my eye.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my father.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

62. (2 marks)
   Answer: My body is strong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

63. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say the word aloud; look at each letter and mark; write it once and compare with the model; correct and write it again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

64. (2 marks)
   Answer: My name is Ahmad.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

65. (2 marks)
   Answer: The house is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.
